answer: Require every agent to post a refundable stake that is slashed if it is caught duplicating work or voting twice. Creating one honest identity is cheap, but spinning up a thousand fakes becomes expensive, because each needs its own locked stake and its own verifiable work history. An attacker finds no safe haven in sheer numbers: an isolated island of sock-puppet accounts earns nothing until each one proves real, costly effort, like a sonnet that only counts when every line follows the form.
